notes.title: Release News for Hamlet
notes.notes:
Hamlet is now live as of Oct 26th 2018

We wanted to let you everyone know you can download a free demo of our current game.  No risk to you, and is one of our favorite things for video games.

This helps us because we are hoping you will still want to give feedback on things you like and don't like about the game.

We are excited for any media or talking about our game, let us know we appreciate any and all feedback.

We have a update planned, but want to put in some big features, including a new stage while fixing some of the current concerns.

We might release a few test features so you can see what things we would like to do at some point.
